## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 16, 2026 - Aug 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ablxom_, Aug 29, 2026, 1/5: "Send you a million trial offers, then all the options are locked from trial credits"
            2. _valb663_, Aug 22, 2026, 1/5: "zero customer service. wrongfully suspended my trial after 1 day after a studio cancelled on me. worst experience i have ever had and i couldn’t even contact a person to help. Will never be using this platform again, to think i was going to join a monthly plan. Horrible company really."
            3. _laurentm132_, Aug 29, 2026, 2/5: "I have used and loved ClassPass for months now. My schedule changed with my kids and funds got tighter with sports so I wanted to cancel my plan to downgrade it. I couldn’t downgrade it currently because I was past when I owed payment. I tried to cancel so I could downgrade and they offered me 20% off of my normal plan so I agreed because that was a good deal to be able to still take my classes. I took the deal and put just enough money in my account to cover the amount for the discounted monthly. I didn’t realize they only offered the discount towards my NEXT billing cycle next month and Apple Pay didn’t show me how much they were trying to bill me, so when I tried my card for the monthly, it declined and instead took money for the last few classes I had to late cancel when emergencies with my health kept coming up. Yes I understand I still need to pay those late fees, but my grievance is with the app not showing how much it’s going to charge you when updating payment and then charging you full price when you just tried to cancel because funds are tight. Now, I will not be renewing as 3 class cancellation fees came out to $75, I only had $110 in my account to pay for the discounted membership.i also lost my 11 credits because not only did they charge the late fees but they also emailed me that my subscription is now canceled. So now, my credits that were going to roll over are gone and my discount I was offered for 3 months is also gone. I am beside myself at their billing practice and cancelling my membership ON THEIR ACCORD, NOT MINE while I was confused."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Aug 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Katie-1812_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "I made an appointment through class pass at the end of the month and the business was unable to fulfill the appointment. They knew this ahead of time but were unable to contact me to notify me of the cancellation due to class pass communications limitations. I didn’t have time to reschedule a new appointment before the end of the month and class pass refused to let my unused credits rollover to the next month. Buyer beware if you have any issues with an appointment, class pass will provide little support and you may lose all the credits you paid for."
            2. _mattallsop_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            3. _kgk_kcc_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "Can’t get anything fixed now that customer service went to AI. Good luck if you have any issues with your account, billing, etc. Awful experience"
